name: newimpl_face_flux_boundaries
reference_schedule: validate; compute_flattening; for direction=1:ndim in ascending order: reconstruct_direction then solve_faces; stop immediately on non-HY_OK

checksummed_arithmetic.description: All decompositions lower the same application-owned arithmetic and helper sources.
checksummed_arithmetic.requirement: Revalidate the arithmetic-helper contract and its three source hashes before generation.

preflight_before_work.description: Argument, extent, workspace, mapping, and parameter validation precedes numerical work.
preflight_before_work.requirement: Initialize status, failed_face, and max_speed exactly as the entrypoint does and launch no computational kernel after failed preflight validation.

helper_branch_order.description: The helper call sequence and all branches are part of the numerical contract.
helper_branch_order.requirement: Do not split, fuse, reorder, or reassociate operations inside a declared operation.

direction_serial_order.description: Directions execute in ascending order from one through ndim.
direction_serial_order.requirement: Complete reconstruction and face solving for direction d before starting reconstruction for direction d+1.

same_direction_reconstruction.description: A face solve consumes the reconstructed states produced for that same direction.
same_direction_reconstruction.requirement: Preserve direction identity across any reconstruction-to-solve kernel boundary.

directional_scratch_reuse.description: Minus and plus reconstruction arrays are reused for every direction.
directional_scratch_reuse.requirement: Finish all reads by solve_faces before reconstruct_direction overwrites either array for the next direction.

max_speed_reduction_order.description: max_speed starts at zero and is updated in the reference direction and face traversal order.
max_speed_reduction_order.requirement: Preserve the max operator, identity, candidate set, NaN behavior, and update order; do not introduce a reassociated parallel reduction.

failure_short_circuit.description: The first non-HY_OK status terminates the stage and records the reference failed face.
failure_short_circuit.requirement: Every later statically scheduled group must test status before numerical work; execute no later face or direction arithmetic after failure, and do not commit partial results when commit_partial_results is false.

single_task_function.description: Kernel grouping is independent of Milhoja TaskFunction grouping.
single_task_function.requirement: All legal kernel groups remain inside one face-flux TaskFunction and reuse one resident DataPacket.

legal_groupings.name: fully_fused
legal_groupings.schedule: validate; compute_flattening; for direction=1:ndim in ascending order: reconstruct_direction then solve_faces; stop immediately on non-HY_OK

legal_groupings.name: flattening_then_directional
legal_groupings.schedule: validate; compute_flattening; for direction=1:ndim in ascending order: reconstruct_direction then solve_faces; stop immediately on non-HY_OK

legal_groupings.name: flattening_reconstruction_solve
legal_groupings.schedule: validate; compute_flattening; for direction=1:ndim in ascending order: reconstruct_direction then solve_faces; stop immediately on non-HY_OK

prohibited_transformations.name: all_directions_reconstructed_first
prohibited_transformations.reason: The reference reuses one minus/plus workspace and consumes each direction before the next overwrite.

prohibited_transformations.name: concurrent_directions
prohibited_transformations.reason: Concurrent directions race on reconstruction scratch and alter failure and max-speed ordering.

prohibited_transformations.name: split_face_solver_helper_chain
prohibited_transformations.reason: Face-local states and branching decisions are private temporaries whose helper order is fixed by the arithmetic.

prohibited_transformations.name: parallel_reassociated_max_speed
prohibited_transformations.reason: A different reduction tree can change NaN handling and the prescribed update order.

prohibited_transformations.name: multiple_task_functions
prohibited_transformations.reason: Phase III changes kernel grouping inside one resident DataPacket, not Milhoja scheduling granularity.
